The Product Manager will define propositions, capacity requirements, and the digital roadmap, collaborating with various departments to ensure end-to-end product performance and governance. Key Responsibilities Define the product vision, value proposition, roadmap, and target customer segments. Prioritize opportunities based on customer insight, market and competitor intelligence, and performance data. Manage business cases, product approvals, launches, adoption, continuous improvement, and retirement. Define service and capacity requirements, while Fleet and Operations manage assets and daily execution. Own product budgets, forecasts, P&L performance, and implement corrective actions. Set rate architecture, route-to-serve, margin floors, and pricing governance in collaboration with Finance. Support Sales with solution design, key bids, product expertise, and bundled propositions. Define service scope, SLAs, operating model, and documentation standards. Partner with operations to ensure on-time delivery, capacity availability, and service quality. 6b020e77cd838c65.description: About the Role Saudi Aramco is seeking a Senior Process Automation Administrator to join the Mechanical Services Shops Department (MSSD) within Technical Services. This full-time role operates within a complex hybrid IT/OT environment, where Operational Technology (OT) systems, including connected machines, Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) sensors, Building Management Systems (Desigo CC), and PLCs, are securely integrated with Information Technology (IT) enterprise systems such as SAP S/4HANA and TeamCenter. Role Context and Purpose The MSSD is a critical manufacturing facility responsible for the repair, overhaul, and fabrication of rotating and static equipment. The Senior Process Automation Administrator will serve as the Technical Authority for this converged infrastructure. This involves leading the security, maintenance, and integration of network automation systems, ensuring robust and optimized secure interfaces between the shop floor and enterprise systems. The role manages network segmentation, server infrastructure, and controls to enable safe, real-time data flow between industrial assets and business applications. Key Responsibilities Lead the administration, security, and maintenance of the Process Automation Network infrastructure, including operational technology networks, on-premise servers, firewalls, switches, and associated network components. Administer server operating systems, virtualization platforms, and supporting infrastructure for industrial and digital applications. Design and manage secure network zones (DMZs) and connectivity to ensure reliable and secure IT/OT connectivity between manufacturing machines, industrial systems, IIoT platforms, facility systems, and approved enterprise systems. Support industrial system interfaces and connectivity, including Open Platform Communications servers, SAP (ERP), TeamCenter (PLM), and approved industrial communication interfaces. Perform security vulnerability management, system hardening, security patching, and remediation coordination for industrial infrastructure in compliance with corporate policies and international safety standards. Monitor security threats, security events, network and server health, system availability and capacity, and lead incident response investigations and root-cause analysis. Manage infrastructure-level user access, privileges, authentication, and security configurations according to company requirements. Manage backup, restoration, and disaster-recovery arrangements for industrial servers and network configurations. Assess infrastructure and security requirements for new hardware, software, devices, interfaces, and system changes before connection to the industrial environment. Lead infrastructure projects from scoping and budgeting to implementation and testing, overseeing contractors and vendors to meet quality, cost, and schedule targets. Mentor and train junior engineers and staff on best practices for security, system administration, and digital tools. Maintain current network architecture, server inventory, configuration, access, security, backup, and recovery documentation. Experience Required Candidates should possess 9-10 years of relevant experience in process automation administration within complex IT/OT environments. Work Environment Saudi Aramco offers professional, technical, and industrial opportunities. The company invests in capital and technology to support world-scale projects and addresses global technical, logistical, and environmental challenges through significant talent development programs. Employees are encouraged to enhance their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through extensive workforce development initiatives.

The specialist will facilitate technical instruction, guide virtual lab exercises, assess participant progress, and support learners through action learning projects and a final program Hackathon. Role Context and Expectations The Infrastructure Specialist is responsible for connecting complex infrastructure concepts to a regulated financial services environment. This position requires deep technical expertise and the ability to serve as a program ambassador, reflecting the quality and rigor expected from a premium training partnership. The specialist will ensure all content is contextualized within the banking and financial services operating environment, drawing on regulatory frameworks and industry best practices. Key Responsibilities Deliver IT Infrastructure Track modules to a high instructional standard, managing pace, depth, and learner engagement during intensive in-person training. Facilitate hands-on virtual lab sessions, guiding participants through real-world configurations in environments such as vSphere, Windows/Linux OS hardening, database clustering, Cisco network engineering, and storage architecture. Administer pre- and post-module assessments and scenario-based exercises, providing structured feedback on participant performance via the program’s LMS platform. Submit Trainer Feedback Reports to the Programme Team, covering content effectiveness, cohort performance, engagement levels, and recommended adjustments. Support the program’s Internal Hackathon as a technical mentor, reviewing IT Infrastructure prototypes for technical viability and alignment with financial services constraints. 6bd35d35238290e4.description: About the Role SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering is seeking a Senior Traffic and Detour Engineer to join their team. This full-time role involves serving as a senior technical specialist responsible for the planning, design, review, and implementation of traffic management and detour strategies for major road and infrastructure projects. The position ensures the safe and efficient movement of traffic during construction and operational phases while minimizing disruption and maintaining network performance. Role Overview The Senior Traffic and Detour Engineer provides technical leadership in the development and evaluation of traffic management plans, detour schemes, and temporary traffic arrangements. This includes ensuring alignment with project objectives, safety requirements, and applicable standards. The role is critical in maintaining operational continuity and safety for road users during significant infrastructure developments. Key Responsibilities Lead the development and review of Traffic Management Plans (TMPs), Detour Plans, and Temporary Traffic Control Plans. Design safe, efficient, and practical detour schemes to accommodate construction activities while maintaining traffic flow. Develop traffic staging and phasing plans aligned with construction sequencing and project delivery schedules. Ensure detour designs address safety, accessibility, emergency vehicle access, and operational continuity. Conduct traffic impact assessments, traffic capacity analysis, and operational assessments to evaluate detour effectiveness. Analyze traffic volumes, turning movements, intersection performance, and road network operations. Utilize traffic modeling and simulation tools to assess and optimize traffic detour and management strategies. Review contractor-submitted traffic management and detour proposals and provide technical recommendations. Provide technical oversight during the implementation of traffic detours and temporary traffic management measures. Conduct site inspections to ensure traffic diversions are implemented in accordance with approved plans and safety standards. Identify traffic risks, operational conflicts, and safety concerns, and implement mitigation measures. Support construction teams to ensure traffic management measures align with project schedules. Coordinate with clients, government authorities, traffic police, and contractors to obtain necessary approvals. Participate in technical coordination meetings and provide expert input on traffic-related matters. Support multidisciplinary coordination with design, construction, and supervision teams. Ensure all traffic management and detour plans comply with national regulations, applicable standards, and project requirements. Ensure proper implementation of traffic safety measures, including signage, markings, barriers, and traffic control devices. Conduct technical reviews and audits to ensure quality and compliance. Prepare and review traffic management reports, detour drawings, technical specifications, and method statements. Maintain documentation of approved traffic management plans and detour implementations. Provide technical reports, progress updates, and recommendations to project leadership. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of experience in traffic engineering, specifically in planning, design, and implementation of traffic management and detour strategies for major road and infrastructure projects. Demonstrated technical leadership in developing and evaluating traffic management plans. Proficiency in traffic modeling and simulation tools. Strong understanding of national regulations, applicable standards, and safety requirements related to traffic management. Benefits and Professional Growth SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering offers rewards and benefits designed to support employees at every stage of their career. This includes opportunities for skill development, expertise expansion, and recognition for contributions.

6b077ba7c33ddd79.description: Lead incident and crisis management for the City Command Unit (CCU). Develop, maintain and assure the framework through which incidents across Qiddiya City are classified, escalated, commanded and resolved – from first report in the control room, through Bronze and Silver coordination, to Gold-level crisis activation – and act as the CCU’s senior incident lead during major incidents and crises. Ensure that incident response is consistent across assets, venues and partners, aligned with the Joint Security Operating Model and the Emergency Response Plan, accurately recorded, and followed by structured review, so that lessons are converted into better plans, procedures, training and decisions. Responsabilities Lead the incident management function within the Crisis Operations sub-department of the City Command Unit, acting as the CCU’s subject-matter lead for incident and crisis management and providing professional direction on incident handling across the unit. Develop and maintain the incident management framework – incident classification and severity levels, the escalation matrix and thresholds, notification cascades and Gold–Silver–Bronze command roles – in line with the Joint Security Operating Model, the Emergency Response Plan and Incident Command System principles, for approval by the Director – Crisis Readiness. Act as the CCU’s senior incident lead at tactical (Silver) level during major incidents and crisis activations, as assigned under the command rota: establish command, set priorities, coordinate the response of Qiddiya’s operational functions and partners, and brief the Director – CCU and City Operations leadership. Assure live incident handling in the control room: support shift managers during significant incidents and ensure that the common operating picture, decision logs and situation reports are maintained and that escalation is timely and accurate. Manage the CCU’s crisis management arrangements – the crisis management room, support to the Gold-level crisis team, the crisis battle rhythm, information management and record keeping – so that the move from incident to crisis is controlled. Coordinate the multi-agency incident response interfaces with the Security Operations Centre, the contracted Fire and Rescue Service, medical response, Transport, the parks and venues and, through the CCU’s liaison arrangements, Civil Defence, Qiddiya Police and other public authorities, so that roles, primacy and handover are understood before and during incidents. Lead the post-incident process – hot debriefs, structured reviews, root-cause analysis and post-incident reports – and maintain the lessons and corrective-action register with named owners, target dates and closure evidence. Analyse incident data and trends, define incident-management performance indicators and report performance and emerging risks to the Director – Crisis Readiness and City Operations leadership, feeding the CCU risk register and readiness assessments. Build incident-command competence across the CCU and its partners: design and deliver training, coaching and assessment for shift managers, operators, duty managers and asset teams in incident command, decision-making, logging and briefing. Ensure incident response procedures, action cards and scenario playbooks are current and usable, working with the Senior Manager – Crisis Readiness and the Manager – Emergency Planning on their alignment with emergency plans and the exercise programme. Bachelor’s degree in Emergency Management, Crisis and Disaster Management, Risk Management, Security Management, Public Safety or a closely related discipline. (Master’s degree or doctorate in a relevant field is desirable.). Recognised emergency- or crisis-management certification (such as Certified Emergency Manager, or training to ISO 22320 incident management and ISO 22361 crisis management) is desirable. Incident-command qualification (Incident Command System or Gold–Silver–Bronze tactical command training) or business-continuity certification (ISO 22301 or CBCI) is desirable. Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in incident, emergency or crisis management, including at least 3 years in a senior role leading incident response or crisis management for a command centre, emergency service, major venue, critical infrastructure or city-scale operation. Experience in giga-project, theme-park, major-event, transport or government emergency-management environments is strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience commanding or coordinating the response to major incidents at tactical (Silver) level or equivalent. Experience developing incident and crisis management frameworks, escalation arrangements and command structures, and embedding them across multiple operators and agencies. Experience supporting or advising a strategic (Gold) crisis management team during live crises and exercises. Experience leading post-incident reviews and converting lessons into tracked corrective actions. Experience working with civil-defence, police and emergency-medical authorities; Saudi Arabia or GCC experience is strongly preferred.

6b681d54dcfd2485.description: About Qiddiya Investment Company Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Manager - Permits and Certification to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and focuses on ensuring Fire and Life Safety (FLS) governance across Qiddiya City assets and activities. Role Summary The Senior Manager will lead FLS governance for permits, certificates, and regulatory assurance. This involves establishing evidence requirements, coordinating technical input for approval processes, and preventing occupation or activation of high-risk activities where life-safety prerequisites are not met. The role is critical in maintaining safety standards and regulatory compliance within Qiddiya City. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain the FLS permits and certification framework, including responsibility matrix, submission standards, workflows, and approval records. Coordinate FLS evidence for Saudi Civil Defense approvals, occupancy and operating prerequisites, internal permit-to-open, and asset activation decisions. Review the completeness and technical adequacy of fire strategies, approved drawings, inspection records, test certificates, integrated test evidence, O&M information, and close-out records. Define mandatory FLS gates for construction completion, handover, fit-out, temporary events, change of use, and operational opening. Maintain a controlled permits and certification register detailing status, conditions, expiry dates, dependencies, owners, and residual risks. Identify gaps, conflicting approvals, expired certificates, or unsupported claims and escalate issues before reliance or operation. Coordinate with Legal, Development, Operations, HSE, asset owners, and authorities to clarify accountabilities and avoid duplication or gaps. Provide FLS recommendations to approval bodies while preserving statutory, project, and operator decision rights. Set evidence requirements for conditional approvals and track conditions, interim measures, and expiry dates to verified closure. Support regulatory inspections and technical meetings with Saudi Civil Defense and other authorities having jurisdiction. Assure change-control processes so significant design, occupancy, or operational changes trigger re-assessment and re-certification where required. Monitor permit and certificate performance, overdue actions, and recurring deficiencies, reporting material exposure to leadership. Develop templates, guidance, and training for applicants, reviewers, and asset operators. Lead and mentor the permits/certification team and support Saudization and competence development. General Responsibilities and Professional Conduct The Senior Manager will comply with Qiddiya governance, confidentiality, records management, delegated authority, HSE, and legal requirements. This includes providing accurate, timely, and auditable advice, managing conflicts of interest, and maintaining professional independence. The role also involves promoting collaboration, transparency, proportionate risk management, and continuous improvement within the team and across departments. Internal and External Interactions Key internal interactions include City Operations FLS, Development and Delivery, Legal, HSE, Asset Management, Facilities Management, Security, CCU, Procurement, document control, and venue and asset operators. External interactions involve engagement with Saudi Civil Defense, municipalities, and other authorities having jurisdiction, as well as designers, contractors, consultants, third-party reviewers, laboratories, certifiers, insurers, and specialist vendors. Application Process Candidates interested in this Senior Manager - Permits and Certification role are invited to apply. Salary details will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

Unifonic is focused on pioneering sovereign, agentic AI through its Agentic Studio platform, fostering an environment of creativity, collaboration, and innovation. This full-time role focuses on regulated industries such as government, financial services, telecommunications, and large enterprises. 6b745ebc5bdd8f22.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أباريل للتجارة عن مدير متجر للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على الأهداف التشغيلية للمتجر، وتخطيط وتنظيم وإدارة العمليات اليومية لضمان الكفاءة والفعالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على وضع الأهداف والخطط التشغيلية للمتجر. تطوير وتنسيق الإجراءات التشغيلية للموظفين وتحديد مهامهم ومسؤولياتهم وتوزيعها. الإشراف العام على أداء المتجر ومتابعة الأنشطة اليومية. ضمان توفير الدعم والمعلومات والموارد اللازمة لفرق العمل لتنفيذ الأنشطة. التأكد من ملاءمة الأنشطة لمعايير الجودة المعتمدة. مراقبة مستوى وكميات السلع والبضائع في المتجر. التنسيق مع الجهات المعنية لتنفيذ طلبات الشراء اللازمة بما يتوافق مع الكميات والمواصفات المحددة. مراقبة التزام موظفي المتجر بالتوجيهات والمهام المسندة إليهم والتأكد من أدائهم الفعال. ضمان تنفيذ إدارة المتجر لكافة الأنظمة والقرارات المتعلقة. التواصل مع الموظفين لتعزيز فهمهم وإحاطتهم بكافة المستجدات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في إدارة المتاجر أو مجال مشابه. القدرة على تخطيط وتنظيم وإدارة العمليات التشغيلية للمتجر. فهم قوي لمعايير الجودة وإجراءات العمل. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية. القدرة على تحديد المهام وتوزيع المسؤوليات بفعالية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتنسيق. القدرة على مراقبة الأداء وضمان الامتثال للمعايير. بيئة العمل يعمل مدير المتجر في مدينة مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الإشراف المباشر على العمليات اليومية للمتجر لضمان سيرها بكفاءة وفعالية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في أباريل للتجارة.

6b9f62ac5b9e29ce.description: About Black Duck Black Duck Software, Inc. assists organizations in building secure, high-quality software, aiming to minimize risks while maximizing speed and productivity. As a pioneer in application security, Black Duck offers SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to identify and resolve vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. Through a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, Black Duck supports organizations in enhancing security and quality within DevSecOps and throughout the software development lifecycle. The Role of Technical Success Manager Black Duck is seeking a Technical Success Manager to join its Customer Success team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time, customer-facing role requires a blend of technical credibility and strong customer relationship management skills. The Technical Success Manager will manage customer relationships post-sale, collaborating with engineering, development, and security teams to ensure successful adoption of Black Duck solutions and measurable value from customer investments. Key Responsibilities Serve as the primary technical Customer Success contact for a portfolio of customers in Saudi Arabia and the wider region as needed. Own the customer success plan from post-sale onboarding through adoption, value realization, and ongoing growth. Build strong relationships across engineering, development, DevOps, security, and executive stakeholder groups. Provide hands-on technical guidance on configuration, tuning, integrations, and product usage. Troubleshoot technical challenges directly, investigating issues and testing different approaches. Deliver product enablement, workshops, and best-practice guidance to customer teams. Help customers integrate application security into their SDLC, CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps workflows. Partner with Customer Success Engineers and other technical specialists for deeper engineering expertise or customized solutions. Monitor adoption and customer health, identifying risks early and developing plans to address them. Lead regular customer reviews that demonstrate measurable technical and business value. Collaborate with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Support, Product, and Engineering to ensure a consistent customer experience. Identify opportunities for customers to expand their use of Black Duck products and capabilities. Customer Success Approach Technical Success Managers focus on three core areas throughout the customer lifecycle: Align: Partner with customers and internal account teams to define success and build a plan to achieve it. Translate business objectives into technical requirements and build relationships with key stakeholders. Adopt: Drive adoption across customer teams, applications, and use cases. Deliver technical enablement, help embed Black Duck into development and security workflows, and identify opportunities for new capabilities. Amplify Value: Continuously revisit success metrics as application security programs evolve. Use data to demonstrate impact, lead business reviews, and develop successful customers into advocates. Required Skills and Experience Candidates should be comfortable discussing application security, the software development lifecycle, and technologies such as Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), and Software Composition Analysis (SCA). Practical, hands-on experience is essential, including the ability to handle technical work from configuration and tuning to product enablement and troubleshooting. The role also requires the ability to lead executive conversations, develop account plans, run business reviews, and build long-term customer relationships. Why Join Black Duck? This role offers an opportunity to work at the intersection of application security, software development, and customer success. You will engage with customers addressing real-world software security challenges and influence the integration of Black Duck within their development and security programs. This position is suited for individuals who are technically hands-on, enjoy solving complex problems, and derive satisfaction from both technical problem-solving and building trusted customer relationships.

6ba8c04801b611a8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تيكنيكال باور عن أخصائي صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تحديد المخاطر المهنية في بيئات العمل، وقياس مستويات السلامة، وتطوير برامج الوقاية، وضمان الامتثال لإجراءات الصحة المهنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة بيئة العمل وتحديد المخاطر الكيميائية والفيزيائية والإشعاعية والبيولوجية. اقتراح أساليب وإجراءات فعالة لتفادي تأثيرات المخاطر على العاملين. تنسيق تحويل العاملين للفحص الطبي الدوري للتأكد من عدم تأثرهم بأمراض مهنية. قياس وفحص مستويات الإضاءة والتهوية والضجيج في مواقع العمل ومقارنتها بالمعايير المقبولة. التوصية بالإجراءات التصويبية اللازمة لتحسين ظروف العمل. مراقبة ومتابعة إجراءات التخلص من النفايات الصناعية السائلة والصلبة لضمان عدم تأثيرها على صحة البيئة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال الصحة المهنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالصحة المهنية وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء تنفيذ مختلف أعمال الصحة المهنية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على تحديد المخاطر الكيميائية والفيزيائية والإشعاعية والبيولوجية. معرفة بإجراءات قياس وفحص مستويات الإضاءة والتهوية والضجيج. فهم جيد لإجراءات التخلص من النفايات الصناعية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد المخاطر وتقييمها. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. مهارات تواصل فعالة لتقديم التوصيات وتوجيه العاملين. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي الصحة والسلامة المهنية ضمن فريق شركة تيكنيكال باور في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية، في بيئة عمل تلتزم بأعلى معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، والراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

الصراف الآلي أو القنوات الإلكترونية الأخرى. توجيه العملاء إلى الموظف المختص. الاستجابة السريعة لمعالجة مشاكل العملاء وتلبية طلباتهم وفق الإجراءات والتعليمات، والمتابعة مع مراقب الفرع لحل المشاكل. استلام طلبات بطاقة الصراف الآلي، إدخالها بالنظام، طباعة البطاقات الفورية، وتسليم البطاقات المجددة للعملاء. استقبال طلبات تحديث البيانات. استلام طلبات قفل الحساب وتعديل بيانات الحساب وتسليمها لمدير العمليات لإدخالها بالنظام. استقبال العميل الموكل، استكمال بيانات نموذج التوكيل، مطابقة التوقيع وإدخاله بالنظام، وطلب تعميد مدير العمليات. استيفاء الأوامر المستديمة للعملاء، إنشاء وتنشيط العضويات، وتحويلها لمدير العمليات لاستكمال إجراءات تنفيذها. التعامل مع طلبات تغيير التوقيع وطلبات تحريك الحسابات. إدخال المطالبات المتعلقة بالصراف الآلي ونقاط البيع في نظام مطالبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي. استقبال مشاكل العملاء وتحويلها لمدير العمليات للعمل على حلها. الاستعلام عن البطاقات الائتمانية وبطاقات الصراف الآلي المسحوبة من الصراف الآلي بالفرع، وتوجيه العميل لاستلامها من كبير الصرافين. تزويد العملاء بمنشورات المنتجات. رفع بلاغات الاشتباه في غسل الأموال وحالات الاحتيال، والإبلاغ عن الحالات المخالفة للأنظمة والتعليمات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 1-5 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مصرف الراجحي في المنطقة الشرقية، وتشمل العمل في عدة مدن لخدمة قاعدة عملاء واسعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه.

6be12cd93403ea38.description: نبحث عن مسؤول علاقات حكومية ذو خبرة للانضمام إلى فريقنا، ليكون حلقة الوصل بين الشركة والجهات الحكومية المختلفة. ستشمل مسؤولياتك بناء علاقات قوية، متابعة الإجراءات القانونية، وضمان الامتثال للأنظمة. نهدف إلى تعزيز تواصلنا الفعال مع الجهات الحكومية لضمان سلاسة العمليات وتحقيق أهداف الشركة.

6b19e4268a141fcc.description: About the Role Al Tuwairqi Group is seeking a Storeman to join their team in Jeddah. This full-time position involves comprehensive material management within the warehouse, focusing on proper storage, identification, and maintaining a clean and organized environment. The role also includes assisting with material issuance and general administrative tasks for the stores department. Key Responsibilities Unload incoming materials, either manually or using a forklift when an operator is unavailable, based on material type. Transport materials from the receiving area to designated main warehouse locations as instructed by the Foreman/Storekeeper or Store Officer. Rearrange warehouse materials under the direct guidance of the Foreman/Storekeeper, storage operator, or store superiors as needed. Attach identification tags to materials in accordance with specified guidelines. Maintain cleanliness and housekeeping standards in all store offices, washrooms, kitchens, and warehouse storage areas. Prepare and serve tea for stores staff as required. Conduct daily housekeeping in the stores and yards, including storage areas, bins, locations, and offices, ensuring cleanliness and neatness. Utilize all safety methods and procedures while handling materials. Assist the Storekeeper in the process of issuing materials to users. Provide support to the Foreman or Storekeeper with general office work. Follow detailed work instructions provided separately for specific tasks. Aid in physical material issuance, receipts, and movements as advised by superiors within the stores department. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 0-1 year of experience in a similar role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, where the Storeman will operate within a warehouse and office environment, collaborating with the stores team and other departmental superiors.

6be086de67f03b30.description: About the Role Converge is seeking a Trade Marketing Manager (POSM and Visual Merchandising) to join a leading FMCG organization in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on developing and executing trade marketing plans to enhance in-store brand visibility and ensure consistent brand execution across various retail channels within the Saudi market. Role Overview The Trade Marketing Manager will lead initiatives related to Point of Sale Materials (POSM) and Visual Merchandising. The position involves overseeing POSM development, establishing visual merchandising standards, and managing trade marketing activities in alignment with commercial objectives. This role is central to driving impactful trade marketing strategies across Saudi Arabia. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute comprehensive trade marketing plans. Ensure strong in-store brand visibility and consistent brand execution across all retail channels. Oversee the development, production, and deployment of POSM. Establish and maintain visual merchandising standards. Manage trade marketing activities in line with commercial objectives. Qualifications and Requirements 7+ years of trade marketing experience within the FMCG industry. Demonstrated experience in managing POSM development, production, and deployment. Practical experience in visual merchandising and in-store brand execution. Experience in developing and implementing trade marketing plans across various retail channels. Strong understanding of the Saudi retail landscape and consumer behavior. Experience managing trade marketing budgets, suppliers, and external agencies. Strong project management and stakeholder management skills. Experience Level This role requires 5-10 years of relevant experience, with a minimum of 7 years specifically in trade marketing within the FMCG sector. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

6b1d436fdf9c1e96.description: About the Role Arctech is seeking a Machine Operator to join our team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time position involves operating and monitoring production machinery within a steel manufacturing environment, ensuring both safe and efficient production processes. Role Overview The Machine Operator will be responsible for the direct operation of industrial machines critical to steel production. This role requires a commitment to maintaining high-quality output and adherence to established safety protocols. Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Operate and continuously monitor industrial machines utilized in steel production processes. Ensure all manufactured products consistently meet specified quality standards. Perform routine basic machine inspections and accurately report any identified issues or malfunctions. Strictly follow production schedules and adhere to all workplace safety procedures. Maintain a clean, organized, and safe working area at all times. Qualifications and Requirements High school diploma or a technical diploma is required. 5-10 years of previous experience in manufacturing or machine operation is preferred. Basic knowledge and understanding of industrial machinery. Ability to work effectively in various shift patterns as required by production demands. Good understanding and practical application of workplace safety procedures. Work Environment This full-time position is based in a steel manufacturing facility within the Makkah region, covering operations in Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves working directly with industrial machinery and requires adherence to strict safety protocols. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

6b3b3b50cf2bfed0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الخليج المتطورة للاستثمار عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التشغيل والصيانة للمعدات الصناعية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات التفصيلية لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، والتي تشمل المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات التوزيع لأنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية، مع الالتزام بتعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها. المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، بما في ذلك نسب التقدم، وعرضها، وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية. معرفة ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تنفيذ مشاريع الشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب: غير معلن.

6b4d6c4f59f6b0d3.description: About the Role Al Ghurair is seeking a Sales Executive to join their team in Makkah, with responsibilities covering both Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time position focuses on achieving targeted retail vehicle sales and profitability, including finance and insurance accessories. The role requires 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Execute the full sales process, facilitating the sale of new vehicles on behalf of the brand. Record and manage each customer enquiry within the dealer management system, ensuring proactive follow-up. Ensure a seamless customer transaction experience, meeting customer expectations in a timely manner. Understand and apply key performance indicators as provided by the line manager. Support the line manager in maximizing the profitability of each sale. Administrative Duties Adhere to the documented sales process, complying with all company and legal requirements. Assist customers in understanding the process and requirements for purchasing a new vehicle. Support the line manager in maintaining sales operations to desired standards in display and presentation. Comply with all Health, Safety, Security, and Environment (HSSE) standards. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in sales, preferably within the automotive or a related industry. A proven track record of achieving sales targets and managing customer relationships is essential. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to Jeddah. The role involves direct customer interaction and adherence to established sales processes within a dynamic retail environment. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to join the Al Ghurair team.

6b8e249bec24983e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صلب تهامة لمنتجات الحديد عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإتمام عمليات البيع بكفاءة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات (السلع والخدمات). إعداد قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء أو زيارتهم لترويج المنتجات وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المخولة. إتمام عملية البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة العملاء وتحصيل ديونهم، وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها للدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على بناء وإدارة علاقات العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قوية في جمع البيانات وتحليلها. القدرة على التفاوض وإتمام الصفقات. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارة الوقت. القدرة على إعداد التقارير المهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل مندوب المبيعات بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، ضمن منطقة مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور زيارات ميدانية للعملاء والتواصل المستمر معهم. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن. سيتم تزويد المرشحين المختارين بتفاصيل إضافية خلال عملية التوظيف.

6ba82f5e0bc82da0.description: About the Role Unilever is seeking an Assistant Factory Cost Controller to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on ensuring operational excellence through accurate factory cost accounting, robust financial controls, and actionable cost insights. The successful candidate will contribute to month-end closing processes, inventory and fixed-asset governance, management reporting, savings tracking, and cost improvement initiatives across the BUL factory. Key Responsibilities Track, analyze, and control manufacturing costs, including raw and packaging materials, labor, utilities, overheads, depreciation, and other production-related expenses. Perform detailed analysis of actual versus standard and budgeted costs, identify key cost drivers and variances, investigate root causes, and ensure accurate allocation of manufacturing costs. Develop and maintain factory and manufacturing budgets in collaboration with production, engineering, and other relevant functions. Partner with cross-functional teams to identify, quantify, and track cost-saving initiatives across materials, production processes, utilities, waste, labor, and factory overheads. Prepare regular production financial reports and performance analysis for management. Deliver accurate and timely month-end cost accounting, including allocations, charge-outs, reclassifications, accruals, and write-offs with complete support. Monitor AUC balances and CAPEX projects, ensuring timely asset capitalization and accurate asset accounting. Ensure compliance with accounting standards and internal control procedures. Support standard costing, inventory valuation, material consumption analysis, stock adjustments, and related controls to ensure accurate product costing and financial reporting. Work closely with production and finance teams to align cost control efforts with overall company objectives. Build business cases for projects by analyzing costs, benefits, and potential risks to support investment decisions. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in a similar financial or cost control role. This position requires a professional who can manage complex financial data and contribute to strategic cost optimization efforts within a manufacturing environment. Work Environment This role is based at the Unilever factory in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The Assistant Factory Cost Controller will be part of a team committed to impactful work, contributing to both business objectives and broader sustainability goals.

6ba9f47f64d6036c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة حامد سعود العتيبي للمقاولات عن فني صيانة أجهزة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في عرعر، الحدود الشمالية. يركز هذا الدور على تشخيص وصيانة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بالإضافة إلى متابعة برامج الصيانة الوقائية لضمان استمرارية الأداء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع المخططات الإلكترونية للمنظومات والتمديدات والأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، وتحديد إجراءات تشخيص الأعطال. تشخيص أعطال المنظومات والتمديدات والأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، وتقدير كمية وتكلفة مواد ومستلزمات الصيانة ومتابعة توفيرها. متابعة إجراءات إصلاح الأعطال وفحص الأجهزة والمعدات بعد الإصلاح للتأكد من دقة أدائها وضبطها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمنظومات والتمديدات والأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية وفقاً للخطط المحددة. إعداد وتقديم وتوثيق وحفظ تقارير العمل المتعلقة بأنشطة الصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال صيانة الأجهزة الإلكترونية. القدرة على تتبع الأعطال الإلكترونية وتحديد أسبابها بدقة. معرفة جيدة ببرامج الصيانة الوقائية وكيفية تطبيقها. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة عرعر، الحدود الشمالية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص في صيانة المعدات الإلكترونية، مما يتطلب الالتزام بجدول العمل المحدد والتعاون الفعال مع الزملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

6baee4126a784cb5.description: About Nestlé Nespresso SA For over 30 years, Nestlé Nespresso SA has developed a coffee system that enables individuals to create barista-quality coffee experiences at home. The company's innovations have redefined coffee enjoyment for millions globally, growing from a foundational idea in Switzerland to a global brand operating in 82 countries. Nespresso integrates sustainability into its operations, aiming for a positive impact from coffee farming to material choices and recycling efforts. The company fosters an inclusive and international work environment, offering opportunities across various functions and regions, including within the broader Nestlé group. Head of Retail Role Overview Nestlé Nespresso SA is seeking a Head of Retail to lead and develop Nespresso sales across its Boutique network in Makkah and Jeddah. This full-time position requires over 10 years of experience and focuses on upholding brand values and international guidelines. The role involves implementing commercial and people management tools to ensure strong sales and profit performance, excellent customer service, and operational efficiency within the retail environment. Key Responsibilities Ensure consistency of the Nespresso Brand and customer experience across all retail channels (Boutiques, Call Centre, e-Commerce, Trade). Support the B2C Commercial Manager in deploying retail elements for an omni-channel B2C business approach. Monitor and improve Boutique service levels to achieve Net Promoter Score and Customer Voice KPIs. Define retail strategy as part of an omni-channel approach to drive sales and profitability through the Boutique Network. Develop activity calendars with commercial and marketing teams and manage product assortment to meet targets. Analyze sales data for retail performance and propose initiatives to drive traffic and sales to boutiques. Ensure boutique operations, maintenance, and safety comply with international guidelines. Drive improvements for operational efficiency in collaboration with other departments. Manage corporate consistency of Visual Merchandising (VM) Guidance and coach leaders on implementation. Conduct regular operational excellence audits, propose corrective actions, and ensure follow-up. Manage Third Parties in line with Nespresso brand purpose, local regulations, and Nestlé standards. Support Boutique Managers in Employee Lifecycle Management and ensure strong management presence through regular visits. Develop commercial, entrepreneurial, and leadership skills for Boutique Management. Promote a positive working environment that encourages teamwork and professionalism. Collaborate with the Market Trainer to address knowledge and development needs. Support retail location strategy, including identifying new locations, relocation, renovation, and pop-up projects. Support contract negotiations with landlords, adhering to international guidelines. Manage boutique projects from initiation to execution, ensuring adherence to budget, schedule, and scope. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in retail management. Demonstrated ability to develop and implement commercial strategies. Experience in people management and organizational development within a retail context. Proficiency in analyzing sales data and identifying market trends. Strong understanding of operational excellence and project management principles. Work Environment and Culture The Head of Retail will operate in a dynamic, inclusive, and international working environment. Nespresso is committed to fostering a culture that supports employee potential and continuous growth. The role is based in Makkah, with responsibilities spanning Jeddah and Makkah, and is a full-time position.

6bf705e6c5479dff.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مجموعة بن لادن السعودية عن فني مساحة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ أعمال المسح المساحي لمختلف المشاريع الإنشائية، بما في ذلك الأبنية والطرق، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الخرائط والمخططات اللازمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستكشافية اللازمة للمشاريع الإنشائية المتنوعة. إعداد المسودات التفصيلية للمنشآت، العوائق، القنوات، والطرق الفرعية. تحديد وتثبيت نقاط الاستناد الرئيسة والفرعية ونقاط الربط. اختيار الأجهزة والأدوات المساحية المناسبة لكل مهمة. تنفيذ أعمال التسوية الطولية والعرضية لشبكات البنية التحتية. إجراء أعمال التسوية الشبكية لمشاريع الأبنية والأراضي. تثبيت مواقع وحدود الأبنية على الأرض بناءً على المخططات. نقل مواقع وحدود الأبنية القائمة وتثبيتها على المخططات. تثبيت مناسيب جميع الأعمال المتعلقة بالمشروع. تثبيت مسارات الطرق وسكك الحديد وتقاطعاتها. توقيع المنحنيات المختلفة وفقاً للمخططات الهندسية. رسم المقاطع العرضية والطولية، المنحنيات الأفقية والرأسية، والمخططات الكنتورية والمساحية المستخدمة في أعمال المساحة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المساحة أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستطلاعية والتسوية المساحية. إتقان استخدام الأجهزة والأدوات المساحية المختلفة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الهندسية ورسمها. بيئة العمل تتطلب الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل في مشاريع مجموعة بن لادن السعودية بالمنطقة الشرقية، وتحديداً في مدينة الدمام. سيعمل فني المساحة ضمن فريق متخصص لدعم المشاريع الإنشائية المتنوعة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق مجموعة بن لادن السعودية، يرجى التقديم لهذه الوظيفة في الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية.

6b150fe2dc36cb67.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المسار المضيء للشحن البري في جدة عن سمسارة شحن للانضمام إلى فريقها. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ربط أصحاب البضائع والعملاء مع شركات النقل وأصحاب الشاحنات، وتنسيق عمليات النقل البري بكفاءة. يتطلب الدور خبرة واسعة في مجال وساطة الشحن والنقل البري. المسؤوليات الرئيسية العمل كحلقة وصل بين أصحاب البضائع والعملاء من جهة، وشركات النقل وأصحاب الشاحنات من جهة أخرى. تحديد وتوفير الشاحنات المناسبة لمتطلبات الشحن المختلفة. تنسيق جميع جوانب عمليات النقل البري لضمان سلاسة التسليم. إدارة العلاقات مع العملاء وشركات النقل لضمان رضا جميع الأطراف. التفاوض على شروط النقل والعمولات أو هوامش الربح. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة لا تقل عن 10 سنوات في مجال وساطة الشحن والنقل البري. فهم عميق لسوق النقل البري ومتطلباته. القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية قوية مع العملاء وشركات النقل. مهارات ممتازة في التفاوض والتواصل. تفاصيل الوظيفة نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. المدينة: جدة. الراتب الشهري: يتراوح بين 3,750 ريال سعودي و 5,625 ريال سعودي. عن الشركة المسار المضيء للشحن البري هي شركة متخصصة في خدمات الشحن والنقل البري، وتسعى لتقديم حلول لوجستية فعالة لعملائها. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل احترافية تدعم النمو المهني لموظفيها. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لشغل هذه الوظيفة.

6b93df9b71810ea0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مجموعة المجال العربي عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات ومضخات التدفئة ومكيفات الهواء. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة بشكل عام، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح نظم التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتعلقة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف لضمان دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال تركيب وصيانة وتصليح أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. فهم جيد لمبادئ تصميم وتشغيل نظم التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الفنية والرسومات الهندسية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق متخصص يلتزم بمعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية. هذا الدور يتطلب العمل بدوام كامل. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة مجموعة المجال العربي.

6baca45fff16dd07.description: About the Role Alturki Holding is seeking a Senior Internal Auditor to join its Internal Audit function in Al Khobar, Eastern Region. This full-time role reports to the Internal Audit Manager and is responsible for executing internal audit engagements to evaluate the design and effectiveness of internal controls across Alturki Holding’s group of companies. The Senior Internal Auditor ensures controls mitigate risks, support regulatory compliance, and enhance operational efficiency and governance practices. Key Responsibilities Define audit engagement objectives and scope, aligning with organizational priorities and audit standards. Identify key risks and controls within business and operational processes under review. Develop comprehensive, risk-based audit programs tailored to specific engagement requirements. Communicate effectively with audit clients, discussing concerns, drafting field memorandums, and updating on engagement progress. Execute audit procedures in accordance with company policies, internal audit methodology, and Global Internal Audit Standards (GIAS). Prepare detailed audit reports, presenting findings and actionable recommendations. Deliver opening and closing presentations to client management to communicate audit scope, findings, and agreed-upon actions. Plan, manage, and execute scheduled audit assignments, ensuring timely and high-quality deliverables. Conduct interviews, document reviews, and process walkthroughs to identify and document internal audit issues. Gather, analyze, and appraise evidence to form objective opinions on the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls and operational efficiency. Perform tests of controls, analytical reviews, and substantive testing, drawing conclusions based on data and samples. Discuss and reach agreement with clients on internal audit findings and recommendations, providing guidance on practical improvements. Draft high-impact reports, communicating audit results clearly through both written and oral presentations. Conduct follow-up reviews to monitor the status of audit points and assess the effectiveness of corrective actions taken. Ensure all audit results and supporting documentation are accurately recorded and retained in line with company policies, internal audit manual, and GIAS. Perform special investigations and ad-hoc assignments as directed, ensuring timely and thorough resolution. Deliver assurance and consulting services related to internal controls, as directed by the Internal Audit Manager. Stay informed on industry trends, emerging risks, and regulatory developments, integrating these into audit planning and execution where applicable. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in accountancy, finance, or a related field. 7 years of internal audit experience. Certification as CIA, CPA, CA, or ACCA is required. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, Eastern Region, within the Internal Audit function of Alturki Holding.

6bbe03f6874d8f2c.description: About Network International Network International is a leading Financial Technology company operating across the Middle East and Africa. The core business is payments, with services provided in over 50 countries, including key markets such as the UAE, Jordan, South Africa, and Egypt. Beyond payments, the company offers services in Data and Insights, Lending, Insurance, and Risk Solutions. Network International primarily serves businesses of all scales and segments, with recent growth in the direct-to-consumer card segment. Role Overview Network International is seeking a Business Development Manager Merchant Acquiring to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for acquiring new merchants, managing strategic customer relationships, and expanding Network International's acquiring business within KSA. The position encompasses the entire customer lifecycle, from prospecting and closing new business to managing and growing existing accounts, with a focus on revenue growth and customer retention. Key Responsibilities Prospect and close profitable new key accounts, contracts, and deals. Secure strategic new business to achieve agreed targets. Manage and grow acquired accounts, ensuring long-term client satisfaction, retention, and revenue growth. Build sustainable business relationships through both business development and account management activities. Conduct market intelligence on significant upcoming opportunities from an acquiring and payments perspective. Plan and develop a healthy sales pipeline of key prospects to achieve assigned business goals annually. Support the overall Business Development strategy for Network across all products, including identifying key segments and accounts, and defining customer propositions and key messages. Learn and professionally present Network's products and services to prospective customers. Develop and maintain strong relationships with potential and existing customers to win profitable business and expand account value. Negotiate commercial terms to maximize Network's long-term profitability. Present Network to potential clients through face-to-face meetings, telephone calls, and emails. Actively manage the entire sales cycle, including lead generation, prospecting, client pitches, negotiations, deal closure, onboarding, and account growth. Own and manage client relationships post-acquisition, serving as the primary point of contact and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and expanding existing client portfolios. Manage and maintain an accurate sales pipeline and ensure all sales administration is current. Create and be accountable for all client proposals, contracts, and related documentation. Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including product, operations, implementation, and technical teams, to ensure successful client onboarding and ongoing support. Ensure Network remains proactive and responsive to prospective and existing clients. Accurately price new relationships in line with agreed pricing policies. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience in business development or merchant acquiring. Our Employee Value Proposition At Network International, we prioritize innovation, agility, and purposeful collaboration within the financial services sector. We invest in our people, empowering them to make decisions, learn quickly, and develop expertise alongside industry leaders. The focus is on solving complex problems and creating value for customers through technology and teamwork. The company fosters a culture built on trust, accountability, and achievement, where success is a collective effort.

6bd212acb849725b.description: About Calo Inc Calo Inc, launched in Bahrain in November 2019, is dedicated to making healthy eating accessible. The company focuses on providing efficient and affordable food access through technology. This full-time position for an Assistant Quality Manager is based in Riyadh and is open to Saudi Nationals Only. Role Overview The Assistant Quality Manager will support the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of Calo Inc's food safety and quality management systems. This role is critical in ensuring that products, processes, and kitchen operations consistently meet regulatory requirements, customer specifications, and company standards. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in food safety and quality assurance within the food and beverage industry. Key Responsibilities Support the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the company's Food Safety and Quality Management System, including HACCP, GMPs, SOPs, and relevant standards such as ISO 22000 and FSSC 22000. Ensure day-to-day kitchen and production operations comply with established food safety procedures, quality standards, and applicable local regulations. Monitor compliance with food safety and quality policies, identifying gaps and recommending improvements where necessary. Support the development, review, and implementation of food safety procedures, work instructions, and quality control processes. Required Activities Conduct routine internal audits and inspections to assess compliance with food safety, hygiene, and quality standards. Support preparations for regulatory, certification, and third-party audits, ensuring the required documentation and records are maintained. Identify non-conformances, investigate underlying causes, and follow up on corrective and preventive action plans to ensure timely closure. Monitor compliance with applicable local and international food safety regulations, including relevant SFDA requirements where applicable. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in food safety and quality assurance within the food and beverage industry. Experience in central kitchen or large-scale food production operations is preferred. Candidates should be proficient in conducting audits, investigating quality issues, implementing corrective actions, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to maintain high standards of food safety and product quality. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working closely with various teams to ensure adherence to food safety and quality standards across all operations.

6bdcbd715d08353d.description: About the Role Chalhoub Group is seeking a Technician Facility Management Tumi to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves inspecting, repairing, and restoring handbags and leather goods to high-quality standards, maintaining their original appearance, and completing repairs within specified timelines. Key Responsibilities Inspect handbags and leather products to identify damages and repair requirements. Perform repairs on handbags, including stitching, zippers, handles, straps, and damaged components. Repair and replace damaged hardware and accessories as needed. Carry out hand stitching and machine stitching using appropriate techniques. Restore damaged leather surfaces while maintaining the original product appearance. Ensure all repairs meet company quality and workmanship standards. Conduct quality checks before and after completing repairs. Handle luxury handbags and delicate leather materials with care. Identify and report any additional damages or repair challenges. Operational and Technical Duties Maintain repair tools, equipment, and materials in good working condition. Ensure the repair workspace is clean, safe, and organized. Complete assigned repair tasks within required timelines. Maintain accurate records of completed repairs and materials used. Apply appropriate leather repair and restoration techniques based on product material. Utilize specialized tools and equipment for leather cutting, stitching, and repairs. Perform leather cleaning, polishing, conditioning, and color restoration as required. Identify suitable repair methods for different types of leather and materials. Administrative Tasks Update and track repair activities within the Focus system. Maintain accurate records of spare parts used for each repair. Keep an updated log of all completed repairs. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in inspecting, repairing, and restoring handbags and leather goods. The role requires a strong understanding of various leather types and materials, along with proficiency in specialized repair techniques and tools. About Chalhoub Group Chalhoub Group is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. The company offers opportunities for professional growth through enriching experiences, learning and development, and internal mobility. They provide a competitive benefits package, including health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies, and employee discounts. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, as the Group ensures equal opportunity without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin, or disability status.

6b7d8ebd594a5dcf.description: About Metichem Metichem is a leading water treatment company specializing in Advanced Chemical Solutions, Engineered Service & Parts and Operations & Maintenance (O&M) services. With a strong heritage as part of the Metito family and now part of Aquatech, Metichem delivers innovative and sustainable solutions across industrial, municipal, and commercial sectors. Our expertise spans water treatment chemicals, RO, wastewater and process water treatment, cooling towers, boilers, engineered systems, digital monitoring automation, and technical support. With service contracts across 46 countries, we help customers optimize resources, improve performance, and reduce environmental impact. About the Role Supports the Chemical Sales Manager and Sales Team in preparing technical proposals for the Industrial & Domestic water treatment markets, including recommended dosage rates and mode of application of products. Works closely with existing and potential customers to analyze their needs and recommend suitable solutions from Company programs, while servicing assigned accounts through regular site visits. Contributes to achieving annual sales targets by obtaining orders, establishing new accounts, and identifying new applications for existing products. Key Responsibilities Achieves annual sales targets by working closely with the Chemicals Sales Manager (CSM) and Business Development Manager (BDM), with the support of Sales Co-coordinator personnel, to establish effective selling strategy and tactics. Obtains orders and establishes new accounts. Plans and organizes daily work and meets the required minimum number of sales calls on existing and potential customers. Analyzes customer needs, requirements, and strategic plans to recommend the most suitable solutions from Company programs. Prepares technical proposals that specify dosage rates and mode of application of products, referring to Technical Support and relevant manuals, particularly where new products or programs are required. Calls on customer facilities to observe and implement the practical application of products. Services assigned accounts, recommends changes in chemical dosages, flow rates, or equipment, and reports any changes or problems to the line Manager and then the customer. Develops existing accounts by seeking new applications for existing products and, with the support of senior sales personnel, the CSM and BDM, develops and executes account sales plans. Maintains close contact with management on customer needs, prices, competitor activity, and METICHEM product acceptability, keeping them informed through regular activity reports, a sales pyramid, and full use of the CRM system. Upholds QHSSE standards by maintaining and improving the BU QHSSE Management System in line with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001, reporting risks and ensuring personal safety and that of others at all times. Qualifications & Experience Degree in Chemical Engineering or a related subject. Minimum of 3 years' previous experience in a similar role within the Water Treatment industry, ideally across sectors such as fertilizer, power, petrochemicals, desalination, and primary metals. Proficient in the use of Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Exposure to Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems would be of benefit. Why Join Metichem? Join a market leader in sustainable water treatment solutions. Be part of an innovative, dynamic, and fast-growing team with real impact on industrial and environmental progress.

6bd43801d29c068e.description: Job description Job Code: 287/001/602 Industry: Manufacturing / Paper Manufacturing / Supply Chain & Warehousing Our client is seeking an experienced Warehouse Supervisor with a strong background in warehouse operations, inventory management, and supply chain activities within the manufacturing industry. The successful candidate will be responsible for supervising warehouse receiving, storage, and dispatch operations, maintaining inventory accuracy, conducting stock reconciliations, and preparing warehouse performance reports. The ideal candidate should have at least 5 years of relevant experience in supply chain or warehouse management , a Bachelor's Degree, and hands-on experience using SAP for warehouse transactions . 6bdb3e17e49ebbbc.description: About The Role About Us Soar is a Saudi fintech startup that specializes in financing and investment. Headquartered in Saudi Arabia and growing throughout the region, Soar’s mission is to help people achieve their financial goals with innovative financial and property investment solutions and tools, delivered through a multi-purpose platform designed for a simple and seamless user experience. The Mission Real estate is one of the largest, slowest-to-change markets on earth. Trillions of dollars in transactions still run on fragmented data, manual workflows, and software that automates paperwork instead of doing the work. We believe that era is over. At Soar, we are building an agentic-first platform: products where AI agents don’t just assist people, they do the work (sourcing, analyzing, negotiating, coordinating, and closing), with humans setting direction and judgment. We are looking for a Head of Product to turn that vision into products people use every day. You will own a core product area end to end, from discovery to launch to scale, and lead the team that builds it. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage a backlog. It is for a builder who wants to ship the first agentic products in a category that doesn’t exist yet. What “agentic-first” means here Most companies are bolting a chatbot onto legacy software. We are doing the opposite: designing the product around autonomous and semi-autonomous agents as the primary way work gets done, with interfaces, data, and trust models built to match. As Head of Product, you will put this thesis into practice: Agents as the core unit of the product, rather than features that wrap a model around old workflows. Outcomes over interfaces. The product should accomplish outcomes, not just surface information. Trust, transparency, and human-in-the-loop by design. Design for the moments where the agent acts on the user’s behalf, and where the human stays in control. Data and feedback as a moat. Build a learning loop where every transaction makes the next one smarter. What you’ll do Own the roadmap. Translate the company’s product vision and strategy into a clear roadmap for your area, with priorities you can defend and adjust as you learn. Ship 0 to 1, then 1 to n. Define the first wedge, take it from blank page to launch, and iterate quickly based on real usage. Lead and grow the team. Hire, coach, and lead product managers and designers, and build a culture of speed, ownership, and craft. Go hands-on with the technology. Work directly with frontier models, agent frameworks, and emerging tooling. Prototype, write specs and prompts, and run experiments to find what works. Make calls under uncertainty. Make fast, well-reasoned decisions with incomplete information, and own the results. Work across the company. Partner closely with engineering, design, data, GTM, and leadership to get the right things built and launched well. Stay obsessed with users. Talk to agents, brokers, buyers, sellers, and investors constantly. Turn the messy reality of real estate into products people love. Requirements Who you are A proven builder. You have shipped products that real people used, ideally including 0-to-1 work where you helped define the problem, not just the solution. Creative and unconventional. You think from first principles, question defaults, and enjoy problems with no established playbook. Fluent in applied AI. You’ve worked with LLMs, agents, or applied AI in production, or gone deep enough to lead a team that does. Execution-focused. You turn strategy into shipped product, set clear goals and metrics, and keep a team moving at high velocity. Strategic and hands-on. You can shape strategy for your area and dive into the details: prototypes, specs, prompts, data, and metrics. A strong people leader. You attract great PMs and designers, help them do their best work, and raise the bar around you. Clear and fast. You move with urgency, communicate with clarity, and care more about impact than process. Bonus points Experience in fintech, marketplaces, agentic applications, or AI research and R&D. Startup or early-stage operator experience. A technical background, or the ability to go toe-to-toe with engineers on agent architecture. A portfolio of products, prototypes, or experiments we can see and play with. Why this role You will be a core member of the product leadership team, with real ownership over what gets built and how. You’ll work alongside the CPO and leadership to shape the product and the team from the early days. The market is enormous, the timing for agentic AI is now, and the upside, in impact and in equity, is real. If you want to build products that change an entire industry, and you’re ready to move fast to do it, we should talk. (edited)
